prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-detailed macro photograph of the inner mechanical workings of a luxury wristwatch, focusing on the intricate gears, levers, and metallic components. The composition highlights the precision engineering, with the word "CALIBRE" and a number clearly engraved on one of the brushed metal plates. The color palette is dominated by cool silvers and greys, with subtle gradients and reflections that emphasize the polished and matte finishes of the metal surfaces. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating gentle highlights and shadows that accentuate the depth and dimensionality of the machinery. The image has a shallow depth of field, with the foreground elements in sharp focus while the background fades into a smooth blur, drawing attention to the fine details of the watch movement. The overall style is clean, modern, and technical, evoking a sense of precision, craftsmanship, and luxury.
